author: GamingBolt
description:
Nioh 3 was definitely going to be measured up against Elden Ring with its revised approach to its level design. But should two games with vastly different approaches even be compared in the first place? We'd say yes since the more we could see differences, the more we saw similarities that showcased how their design choices had similar ambitions with unique approaches. 

Nevertheless, putting these two hard-hitting titles in conversation with each other provides the scope for an interesting look at just how far the Soulslike genre has come in the past decade or so. It’s also a lot of fun to see how these games have risen to the pinnacle of the franchises that inspired them, a journey that has been long yet fruitful.
title: How Does Nioh 3 Stack Up Against Elden Ring?

author: GamingBolt
description:
The 9th Charnel might have been a solid title if it knew what it was doing. But that's not the case here, and the gameplay and story on offer here suffer for it. It's a survival horror experience that leaves you more mildly amused than actually scared for your life. 

That's an absurd way to feel about a game but this one manages that feat quite early on in its runtime. This title needed more time on the drawing board and in the shop before it hit the shelves, and as such, is a hard sell even if you're just looking for a title that's so bad it's good. 

Michael and Jacus' story isn't compelling enough for me to recommend, and the scary ravine is nothing more than a decoration and narrative prop. This one's a pass for us.
title: Is This The WORST Game of 2026?
